title: Multilevel Fair Allocation under Additive Preferences
abstract: arXiv:2608.24400v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study multilevel fair resource allocation with tree-structured hierarchical relations among agents. At each level, the problem can be viewed locally as allocating an agent's bundle to its children, the overall allocation being a trace of this process iterated down to the leaves. Assuming that internal nodes' utilities are the utilitarian welfare of their children, and the leaves have classical additive utilities over items, we first propose multilevel adaptations of usual envy-based fairness notions (e.g., WEF1). We present three adaptations and show that the choice among them is not neutral. We prove that, under identical preferences, the three adapted envy-based notions coincide, and that the Multilevel extension of Weighted Round Robin (Chakraborty et al., 2021) (MWRR) guarantees them. translated_title: 加性偏好下的多级公平分配
translated_abstract: 我们研究了代理之间存在树状层级关系的多级公平资源分配问题。在每一级，问题可以局部视为将某个代理的捆绑资源分配给其子代理，整体分配则是该过程迭代到叶节点的轨迹。假设内部节点的效用是其子节点的功利主义福利，而叶节点对物品具有经典加性效用，我们首先提出了基于嫉妒的公平性概念（如WEF1）的多级改编版本。我们提出了三种改编，并表明它们之间的选择并非中性。我们证明，在相同偏好下，三种改编的基于嫉妒的概念是一致的，并且多级加权轮询（Chakraborty等人，2021）的扩展（MWRR）能保证这些概念。然后，我们表明在一般偏好下，MWRR可能保证某些概念但无法保证其他概念。最后，通过实验，我们展示了MWRR的表现。
tldr: 本文提出了多级公平分配中基于嫉妒的公平性概念的多级改编，并证明了在相同偏好下这些概念一致且MWRR算法能保证它们，但在一般偏好下只能部分保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes multilevel adaptations of envy-based fairness notions for hierarchical resource allocation, proving their consistency under identical preferences and MWRR's guarantee, with partial guarantees under general preferences.
